doc.name: B — editorial frames, vineyard harvest dusk (dawn), graphic hard-shadow minimalism

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: vineyard harvest dusk (dawn)
Register: graphic hard-shadow minimalism
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 6
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in a vineyard harvest dusk (dawn), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a vineyard harvest dusk (dawn), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a low-angle frame of the male lead against the sky or ceiling, featuring the male lead from below.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 28mm at f/8, using a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge, at a medium shot.

LIGHT. Tungsten practicals in frame carrying the warm layer. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a vineyard harvest dusk (dawn), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a solo portrait of the male lead, featuring the male lead alone, chest-up.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 28mm at f/1.8, using a stacked layered composition with three depth planes, at a profile side frame.

LIGHT. Bare-bulb specular light producing tight, hot speculars. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a vineyard harvest dusk (dawn), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a back-of-head frame of the female lead facing away into the scene, featuring the female lead from behind.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 100mm macro at f/5.6, using a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third, at a medium close-up.

LIGHT. North-facing window light with a black v-flat for negative fill. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a vineyard harvest dusk (dawn), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a mirror or reflection frame carrying both leads, featuring both leads via a reflective surface.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 28mm at f/22, using frame-within-frame using foreground architecture, at a profile side frame.

LIGHT. Scrim-diffused midday daylight, one stop under the ambient. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a vineyard harvest dusk (dawn), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a two-shot of both leads sharing the frame, featuring both leads, medium two-shot.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 90mm tilt-shift at f/11, using a stacked layered composition with three depth planes, at a low-angle hero frame.

LIGHT. Tungsten practicals in frame carrying the warm layer. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 90mm tilt-shift at f/16, using diagonal dynamic balance across the frame, at a wide shot.

LIGHT. Blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
